limitations.title: Too much applies at the start of a task
Short helper windows start without the session's lessons
Nothing fails, so no lookup starts
A lookup can cost as much as fixing it
The lookup comes after the failed call is paid
The cause sits outside the window that fails
The failure happens where no session is watching
Operator hazards are reached only by the right verb
Symptom words miss lessons stored in mechanism words
The query carries the asker's own worry or guess
Stored strong-model solutions carry defects nobody has found yet
A near match may need the opposite fix
One fact, different right answers in each project
Same words, different cause: a look-alike comes back
The earlier knowledge-store design has no path between projects
Partial matches disagree, and nothing says which governs
Half-right entries make an open problem look closed
New work copies the nearest old piece, flaws included
Lessons share no step to join on
One symptom, two causes: a correct hit stops searching
The answer holds two cards; merges needed four parts
The first time is full price
Empty at the start; the first weeks cost more
Popular entries get fetched more and so look better
Fixes that hide a symptom match the most problems
Parallel windows pay before any entry can exist
Compaction drops a fetched entry
In the window is not the same as used
Two checked answers do not make a checked merge
Order matters when lessons are merged
Matching the strong model also matches its mistakes
Reviews are costly and still pass wrong conclusions
Some entries have no check a machine can run
Tests stay green; someone else finds the defect later
The entry's own test certifies the defect
The real check happens outside: cloud, deploy or field
A correction tested elsewhere overturned a right entry
A rerun passes whatever was done
Checks built from the conclusion share its blind spot
A check built on the old fix misses recurrence
Higher tiers lack the missing fact too
Higher tier was not who caught the error
A trade between lessons ends with the owner
An error line is not always a failure
Hard problems pay every rung of the ladder
Fewer problems reach the top model to be stored
The handoff is a polluted window or failed brief
'Solved' moves after the entry is written
A conditional 'no' hardens into 'never'
The writer cannot know which details will matter
Asides and observations are never 'a problem solved'
Few observations get stored as a general rule
Scope falls off an entry when written or copied
The after-the-fact write-up misstates what happened
Solvers already write the lesson where builders look
Writing happens in a full window that may compact
Writing keys on what was hard for the solver
Facts outside the repository change with no event
Corrections do not reach the copies
A later fix silently changes an older entry's truth
A stored conclusion answers its own day's question
Repairing an entry can cost more than the fix
Evidence against an entry stays inside helper windows
Blame is unclear when a reused entry fails
Storing merged answers fills the library with combinations
A new model changes which entries are needed
The owner's corrections change and conflict over time
Private details travel with entries
Untrusted text can become trusted memory
